title: Dolphins Answer Only to Their Own Name Whistle

scenes.text: Wild dolphins have names, and they answer to them.
Each bottlenose dolphin has its own signature whistle.
About half of all its whistles are that one signature.
In 2013, scientists off Scotland played recordings of different whistles to wild dolphins.
Each dolphin only responded to a recording of its own whistle.
Dolphins can even copy a friend's whistle to call them. Yes, dolphins have names.

description:
Wild dolphins have names, and they answer to them.
Bottlenose dolphins use signature whistles, and in 2013 a Scottish study found each dolphin only reacted to a recording of its own.
What would your whistle name sound like?
first_comment: If you had a whistle name, what would it sound like?
